messages.subject: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
We received the damage assessment of EUR 300 for the scissor lift (10m) under RB-20263103. We'd like to request that this charge be waived. We rent from you regularly and have always returned equipment in proper condition. This feels excessive for what was really minor wear.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for letting us know. I've noted your request regarding the damage charge and will look into the details. I'll get back to you once I've reviewed it.

Elina Rahkonen
Senior Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
Could you also send us a copy of the invoice? We need it for our records.

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
Of course. Could you specify which invoice you're referring to? We have several on file for your account.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Damage charge on booking RB-20263103
messages.body:
One more thing - we have a job coming up that needs a hydraulic concrete breaker. Do you offer delivery or would we need to pick it up ourselves?

Rakennus Ylitalo & Pojat Oy
